_comment: Mage: The Ascension 2nd Edition (White Wolf, WW4300) as a byo-rulebook module. This file ships the STRUCTURE of the game — what each table is, where it is printed, and how to check it — and no rulebook values. The values come from the reader's own copy and land in corrections.local.json / tables.local.json, neither of which is committed. See README.md for why every locator here is 'manual'.

source.title: Mage: The Ascension, 2nd Edition
source.text_layer_note: The reference scan (Acrobat 5.0 Image Conversion, 2003) carries NO text layer at all: 'pdftotext' over all 314 pages yields zero characters. Every locator below is therefore 'manual'. page_offset 17 was calibrated against the pages the book prints on itself (PDF 19 = printed 2, PDF 22 = printed 5) and verified at both ends of the book; 'page' fields below are PRINTED page numbers, so PDF page = page + 17.

tables.title: Difficulty ratings
tables.note: Image-only scan. Difficulties 2 and 10 exist but are printed as prose below the chart, not as rows, so they are not included here; the standard difficulty is 6.

tables.title: Degrees of success
tables.note: Image-only scan.

tables.title: Health levels
tables.note: Image-only scan, and the printed chart is a bare column: seven level labels against only five printed penalties, because Bruised and Incapacitated have no number. CONFIRMED 2026-09-19 by the book's owner that Incapacitated is n/a; Bruised = 0 rests on the effect line printed beside it ('no action penalties'). A positional parser would silently shift every row by one, which is why this is entered by hand and why extraction_risk stays high.
tables.confirmed: 2026-09-19, against the printed page, by the book's owner

tables.title: Normal healing times
tables.note: Image-only scan.

tables.title: Casting difficulty by Effect type
tables.note: Image-only scan. From the Casting Magick chart. Difficulty = highest Sphere used + this value; minimum difficulty 3, and the modifier total is capped at +/-3.

tables.title: Paradox gained on a botch
tables.note: Image-only scan. Printed as three prose lines on the Casting Magick chart rather than as a ruled table; split here into a flat component and a per-dot component so it can be computed. Paradox = flat + per_sphere_dot x (dots in the highest Sphere used).

tables.title: Magick difficulty modifiers
tables.note: Image-only scan. Modifier is kept as a label, not signed_int, because several entries are ranges ('-1 to -3') or conditional ('-1 per point spent, max. 3/turn'). Chart header: maximum modifier +/-3, minimum difficulty 3, maximum 10.

tables.title: Degrees of success for magick
tables.note: Image-only scan. Printed as a bulleted list, not a ruled table; the threshold column is the percentage of required successes the book states for each degree.

tables.title: Damage and duration by successes
tables.note: Image-only scan.

tables.title: Spirit Gauntlet chart
tables.note: Image-only scan. Technocracy labs carry a footnote: Technocratic dimensional science treats these like Nodes.

tables.title: Correspondence ranges
tables.note: Image-only scan. The chart says to use range or connection, not both.

tables.title: Time Sphere effect timespans
tables.note: Image-only scan. The five-success row prints as a bare '100' with no unit, between '50 years' and '500 years'. CONFIRMED 2026-09-19 by the book's owner as 100 years — the unit was dropped in the printing, not in the transcription. extraction_risk stays high because the missing unit would defeat a parser again, not because the value is in doubt.
tables.confirmed: 2026-09-19, against the printed page, by the book's owner

tables.title: The nine Spheres, levels one to five
tables.note: Image-only scan. From the Magick Cheat Sheet: nine Spheres x five ratings = 45 rows. Where a rating lists several named Effects the book stacks them under one dot rating; they are joined with '; ' in the effects cell.

tables.title: Attributes by category
tables.note: Image-only scan.

tables.title: Character creation allocations
tables.note: Image-only scan. The printed chart heads its third step 'Step Three: Select Attributes' and warns 'No Attribute higher than 3 at this stage' where both should read Abilities — a known erratum in this printing, recorded as printed with the correction noted in corrections.local.json.

tables.title: The Traditions and their specialty Spheres
tables.note: Image-only scan. Ten rows: the nine Traditions plus the Hollow Ones, who are not a formal Tradition and whose specialty Sphere is printed as 'Any'.

tables.title: Backgrounds
tables.note: Image-only scan. Summaries are one-line paraphrases of what each Background covers mechanically, not the book's printed descriptions.

tables.title: Freebie point costs
tables.note: Image-only scan. Cost is a label because Quintessence is priced per four dots rather than per dot.

tables.title: Experience point costs
tables.note: Image-only scan. Cost is a label because most entries are multipliers on the current rating rather than flat numbers.

tables.title: Melee weapons table
tables.note: Image-only scan, and the chart is printed on a tilted 'sheet of paper' graphic, so the value columns sit visibly higher than the labels they belong to. Conceal codes: P pocket, J jacket, T trenchcoat, N cannot be concealed.

tables.title: Brawling table
tables.note: Image-only scan. Bite and Claw carry the footnote 'when applicable'.

tables.title: Do strike chart
tables.note: Image-only scan.

tables.title: Firearms table
tables.note: Image-only scan, but this is the one properly ruled table in the combat chapter, so the columns are unambiguous. Clip is a label because most entries are of the form '17+1' (magazine plus one chambered). Types marked * in the book can fire full-auto or bursts; the crossbow carries a separate ** footnote.

tables.title: Armor
tables.note: Image-only scan.

tables.title: Firefight complications
tables.note: Image-only scan on a tilted graphic. Sixteen labels against fifteen printed entries in the Dice column: 'Multiple shots' has no dice entry, visible only as a gap in the column. CONFIRMED against the printed page by the book's owner (2026-09-19) — Multiple shots takes a difficulty modifier only, and the rows below it are Full-auto +3/+10, Three-round burst +1/+3, Spray 5 +1/yard/+10. extraction_risk stays high because the page remains hostile to any parser, not because the values are in doubt. Difficulty is a label because two entries are formulae ('+1/extra shot', '5 +1/yard').
tables.confirmed: 2026-09-19, against the printed page, by the book's owner

invariant_types.rows:N: the table must have exactly N rows
invariant_types.unique:COL: values in COL must be distinct
invariant_types.monotonic_asc:COL: COL must be non-decreasing down the table
invariant_types.monotonic_desc:COL: COL must be non-increasing down the table
